rationale: Three-point Volt-VAR curve designed to minimize reactive power while keeping all corrected voltages within [0.95, 1.05] pu. At low voltage (0.94), inject 15 kVar (q_frac=0.15) to raise voltage to 0.9505 pu. At nominal voltage (1.0), no reactive command. At high voltage (1.07), absorb 30 kVar (q_frac=-0.3) to lower voltage to 1.049 pu. Curve is strictly increasing in voltage_pu and monotonically non-increasing in q_fraction.
